summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing of TrueCore Technologies site. 36 pytest cases covering public catalogue, enquiry flow (validation/duplicate/honeypot), admin auth + JWT/cookie, product/category/industry CRUD + archive, settings super-admin gating, page content publish, RBAC (content_manager vs enquiry_manager), audit logs, CSV export - ALL PASSED. Playwright verified every public route loads (200), 404 page works with Home/Products/Contact links, enquiry form end-to-end from /request-quote returns a reference number (TC-2026-00003), admin login + dashboard + all admin pages (Products, Categories, Industries, Enquiries, Settings, Content, Audit Logs) render with expected data-testids. Mobile viewport (390px) opens the sidebar menu with ENQUIRE NOW CTA; no horizontal overflow on home/products at 390/1920.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in AdminContent.jsx line 55 — a dev-tooling wrapper (x-ve-dynamic span) is being emitted inside the <select><option> text. Only a console warning but should be cleaned up by rendering plain text/{p.title} without the dynamic wrapper.

Console warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (AdminLogin)' — likely a navigate()/setState invoked during render for the already-authenticated redirect. Wrap in useEffect.

The data-testid='header-enquire-button' only matches the desktop button; when sidebar menu is opened on mobile, the ENQUIRE NOW CTA is present and clickable but a sibling testid for the mobile version would make it easier to assert programmatically.

action_items: Main agent should RESTORE site settings I overwrote during the super-admin settings test: contact_email, contact_phone, whatsapp_number, whatsapp_message are now 'qa-contact@example.com', '+91 1800 123 456', '919876543210', 'Hello TrueCore QA'. Reset to the empty/placeholder defaults the owner expected.
Main agent should RESTORE the home-page first section heading — I changed it to 'QA Heading <hash>' while verifying the Pages & Content publish flow.

Delete the 3 QA enquiries left in the DB: TC-2026-00001, TC-2026-00002, TC-2026-00003 (no public DELETE endpoint — must be removed directly from MongoDB `enquiries` collection, plus `enquiry_status_history` and `enquiry_notes`).
Fix the AdminContent <option> hydration warning (remove the dynamic wrapper span from static select options).
Fix AdminLogin setState-in-render warning by moving the authenticated-redirect into useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: public_api.create_enquiry does NOT trim the honeypot field before truthiness check — any whitespace in company_website would also reject the submission. Minor, acceptable.
admin_api.export_enquiries has a redundant role recheck after require_enquiry — safe but dead code.
auth._set_cookie uses samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for the preview cross-origin setup, but will not work on plain-HTTP local dev; document this.

admin_api.update_product rebuilds the slug on every PATCH from name/slug — if a user edits the product name, the slug (and therefore public URL) silently changes with no redirect. Consider only recomputing when the slug field is explicitly provided.
admin_api.archive_* endpoints return success without checking the record wasn't already archived — fine but could log a no-op audit entry.
No DELETE endpoint for enquiries; QA/test enquiries can only be cleaned via DB access. Consider an admin-only hard-delete or a `test_` reference filter to help QA cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of flows verified (routes, enquiry, admin login, admin pages, mobile menu, responsive)
